description: This file contains functions for parsing and validating Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), including extracting CRL data, checking signatures, and verifying revocation status of certificates within the context of X.509 PKI.

classes.name: ParsedCrlTbsCertList
classes.description: Structure representing the parsed TBSCertList component of a CRL, including fields like version, signature algorithm, issuer, update times, extensions, and revoked certificates.

methods.name: ParseCrlCertificateList
methods.description: Parses a DER-encoded CRL to extract the TBSCertList, signature algorithm, and signature value.

methods.name: ParseCrlTbsCertList
methods.description: Parses the TBSCertList DER-encoded data to extract version, signature, issuer, update times, extensions, and revoked certificates.

methods.name: CheckCRL
methods.description: Validates a CRL against a certificate chain and distribution point, checking signatures, issuer match, revocation status, and CRL validity period.
